mainEntity.name: Can an Evoque or Discovery Sport Ingenium engine fit my Discovery 5?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not directly. Those models use transverse installations, while the Discovery 5 engine is mounted longitudinally with different ancillaries. We check your VIN and engine code before recommending a compatible replacement.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Ingenium engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Discovery 5 Ingenium engine supply only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery 5 204DTA engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a DPF or turbo, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204DTA engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver 2.0 Ingenium engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Discovery 5 engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
